mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions with temperatures sitting at 70 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park. Keep an eye on the sky tonight, as the ISS will be visible for five minutes starting at 6:32 AM, rising in the northwest over Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot.

The Verona Senior Center is reminding everyone that they offer daily meal options prepared by TNT Catering. You can order grab and go meals for pick up or dine in, or sign up for home delivered meals by contacting their office. Additionally, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving along with utility work complete and concrete work currently underway.

We have plenty happening in the area! Today you can visit Insight Wellness for yoga, stop by ART House 360 for their Thursday night series, or head to Hop Haus for trivia. Looking ahead, Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee have live music starting tomorrow, and the Dane County Farmers' Market returns to the square this Friday.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15, they arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving a report of dangerous driving. Thankfully, there were no injuries reported during the incident.
Today's delicious flavor of the day at Culver's of Verona is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM, so make sure to stop by and enjoy a treat.
